engine: PostgreSQL 17.4 on x86_64-pc-linux-gnu, compiled by emcc (Emscripten gcc/clang-like replacement + linker emulating GNU ld) 3.1.74 (1092ec30a3fb1d46b1782ff1b4db5094d3d06ae5), 32-bit

checks.name: Product fault: refund captured goods and shipping without any quality inspection
Deliberate refusal: refund goods and retain delivery fee
Unpaid goods with shipping-only cash collection: no goods refund and no PAID flag
First unpaid order cannot be confirmed without phone confirmation
First unpaid order can be confirmed after a successful staff call
Paid first order has PENDING_PAID and does not require the mandatory phone call
Repeat unpaid order does not require the mandatory call
Unconfirmed cause cannot select a refund policy
Partial physical receipt cannot be marked complete
Duplicate receipt/payment notifications do not duplicate a refund obligation
Completed receipt quantities cannot be changed silently
Cross-order returned-line association is rejected
Refund request alone cannot become SUCCEEDED without settlement evidence
Reserved stock cannot exceed available on-hand balance
Unsupported payment method is rejected rather than silently adding gateways
Product-fault unpaid return has no prepaid goods refund
Unconfirmed first-order call does not automatically cancel the order
Verified excess capture is preserved and blocked from an invented automatic overpayment policy
Independent initial pending states cannot transition between each other
Legacy parent PENDING is not a valid order state

limits: Isolated in-memory PostgreSQL-compatible PGlite check. Not a PostgreSQL 16 deployment, provider payout test, authorization test or multi-session concurrency proof.
